caption: The drawing depicts a flat, side-profile figure of a person walking to the right. The figure is rendered in shades of brown and muted yellow, with some dark gray or black accents, especially on the boots, hat, and sword. The person wears a large hat with a pronounced brim, a coat with visible lapels, and knee-high boots. The left arm bends behind the back, and the right arm extends forward, holding a curved sword with a prominent handguard. The figure's features, such as the nose, mouth, and eye, are outlined and slightly exaggerated in profile. The entire figure stands on two rectangular bases, one under each foot, and the drawing is set against an off-white or light beige plain background.
title: Weather Vane - Count Casimir Pulaski
